purpose: Evidence-backed bulk calculations plus explicitly opted-in, non-predictive encounter sensitivity scenarios
research_pass_activation_changes: The measured aqueous isotropic gSQ is the only active encounter datum; surrogate, analogue, gas, matrix, protein, and validation values remain inactive unless explicitly approved for a named scope.

evidence_backed.limitations: Bulk bimolecular and condition-matched downstream calculations only; encounter yields are refused.

sensitivity.limitations: Illustrative encounter and missing-interaction values are not estimates, priors, confidence intervals, or predictions.

unpolarized.evidence: degeneracy only; not a measured birth state

duration_s.limitations: Illustrative encounter duration retained for named sensitivity scenarios; no exact-system residence-time measurement is available.

field_t.limitations: Chosen sensitivity field, not an experimentally matched condition.

g_radical.environment: N2-purged 100 mM phosphate with xanthine/xanthine oxidase
g_radical.source: Kalyanaraman et al., Archives of Biochemistry and Biophysics (1991), doi:10.1016/0003-9861(91)90023-C
g_radical.limitations: Measured isotropic one-line signal; no resolved g tensor, no hyperfine tensor, and no encounter-specific value.

g_oxygen.limitations: Free-electron-like illustrative value retained only for named sensitivity scenarios; not measured for the solution-phase encounter.

exchange_rad_s.limitations: Disabled because the exact-system exchange coupling is unavailable; zero is not a physical measurement.

dipolar_rad_s.limitations: Disabled because distance, orientation, and spin density are unavailable; zero is not a physical measurement.

dipolar_axis.limitations: Inactive placeholder axis because the dipolar term is disabled.

oxygen_zfs_d_rad_s.limitations: Disabled because encounter-specific O2 ZFS is unavailable; zero is not a physical measurement.

oxygen_zfs_e_rad_s.limitations: Disabled because encounter-specific O2 ZFS is unavailable; zero is not a physical measurement.

effective_hyperfine_rad_s.limitations: Disabled because resolved exact-system hyperfine parameters are unavailable; zero is not a physical measurement.

radical_relaxation_s.limitations: Disabled because exact-system spin-relaxation rates are unavailable; zero is not evidence of absent relaxation, and any nonzero use must be illustrative sensitivity analysis.

oxygen_relaxation_s.limitations: Disabled because exact-system spin-relaxation rates are unavailable; zero is not evidence of absent relaxation, and any nonzero use must be illustrative sensitivity analysis.

k_doublet_s.limitations: Disabled sensitivity-only first-order encounter rate. The measured bulk M^-1 s^-1 constants are never substituted or converted here.

k_quartet_s.limitations: Disabled sensitivity-only rate corresponding to an illustrative k_Q/k_D ratio; no exact-system spin-resolved measurement exists.

k_escape_s.limitations: Disabled sensitivity-only escape rate; encounter geometry and residence time are unavailable.

superoxide0_m.limitations: No predictive starting concentration is defined.

k_spont_m_inv_s.limitations: Disabled effective coefficient; evidence-backed calculations use species-resolved measured rates and explicit acid-base speciation.

k_sod_m_inv_s.source: H. J. Forman and I. Fridovich, Archives of Biochemistry and Biophysics 158(1), 396-400 (1973), doi:10.1016/0003-9861(73)90636-X
k_sod_m_inv_s.limitations: Disabled outside the measured enzyme and conditions; not approved as a universal biological surrogate.

sod_m.limitations: Disabled illustrative concentration. Zero is a scenario choice, not evidence for absence of SOD.

k_h2o2_loss_s.limitations: Disabled because compartment-specific catalase, peroxidase, and transport loss is unavailable; zero is not evidence of no loss.

samples.limitations: Disabled numerical sensitivity setting; convergence must be checked.

doxorubicin_semiquinone_g_isotropic.environment: N2-purged 100 mM phosphate with xanthine/xanthine oxidase
doxorubicin_semiquinone_g_isotropic.limitations: Isotropic one-line signal; not an oxygen g value, tensor, or encounter-specific measurement.

doxorubicin_semiquinone_plus_oxygen_1981.source: B. A. Svingen and G. Powis, Archives of Biochemistry and Biophysics 209(1), 119-126 (1981), doi:10.1016/0003-9861(81)90263-0
doxorubicin_semiquinone_plus_oxygen_1981.limitations: Bulk bimolecular validation datum only; never an encounter-level first-order rate in s^-1.

cuzn_sod_superoxide.source: H. J. Forman and I. Fridovich, Superoxide dismutase: A comparison of rate constants, Archives of Biochemistry and Biophysics 158(1), 396-400 (1973), doi:10.1016/0003-9861(73)90636-X
cuzn_sod_superoxide.limitations: A surrogate outside the reported isoform and conditions.

doxorubicin_semiquinone_plus_oxygen_pH6.environment: aqueous phosphate/formate; O2 or O2/N2 purged
doxorubicin_semiquinone_plus_oxygen_pH6.limitations: Total bulk rate; not spin-resolved and not an intracomplex first-order rate.

doxorubicin_semiquinone_plus_oxygen_pH11.species: deprotonated adriamycin semiquinone plus neutral O2
doxorubicin_semiquinone_plus_oxygen_pH11.environment: aqueous borate/OH-; O2 or O2/N2 purged
doxorubicin_semiquinone_plus_oxygen_pH11.limitations: Total bulk alkaline rate; not spin-resolved and not an intracomplex first-order rate.

exact_study.method: EPR, ENDOR, TRIPLE resonance, partial deuteration
exact_study.limitations: Accessible abstract confirms resolved assignments were investigated but does not expose numerical constants, tensor components, signs, isotope map, solvent, temperature, pH, charge state, or uncertainty. No value is activated.

aqueous_linewidth_pH7_5.limitations: Unresolved hyperfine and other broadening; cannot uniquely convert to T2.

gas.limitations: Gas rovibronic Hamiltonian and convention; not transferable to solution.

matrix_nitrogen.species: neutral O2 diluted in solid N2
matrix_nitrogen.limitations: Temperature-dependent frozen matrix; signal vanishes above 25 K.

bulk_solution.limitations: Bulk-fluid relaxation scale, not direct time-domain T1 or encounter-specific tensor/relaxation.

protein_cavity.species: neutral O2 in T4 lysozyme L99A
protein_cavity.limitations: Wrong protein/environment; demonstrates rapid orientational averaging, not a doxorubicin encounter Hamiltonian.

membrane.limitations: Located membrane studies quantify collisions through spin-label relaxation, not O2 g, D, E, or encounter-specific O2 relaxation.

doxorubicin_semiquinone_encounter.limitations: No exact-system O2 g/D/E tensor or relaxation value found.

geometry_exchange_dipolar_association_se.limitations: No exact-system r, orientation, J, dipolar tensor, association/separation constants, or cage duration found.

coherence.limitations: No D/Q populations, transient polarization, quantum beats, CIDEP/CIDNP, or state-resolved field-dependent product branching.

k_Q_over_k_D.limitations: Only dimensionless illustrative benchmarks are retained in sensitivity_grid.

k_O2minus_O2minus.limitations: Not the common effective neutral-pH dismutation coefficient; later reevaluation reports a tighter upper limit.

k_CuZnSOD_overall.limitations: Not a universal human SOD1/SOD2 rate.

beef_heart_submitochondrial_H2O2.limitations: Detection limit and exact conditions not reported in accessible abstract.

Ehrlich_microsome_superoxide.environment: 200 ug microsomal protein in 1 mL; 150 mM potassium phosphate; 100 uM EDTA; 1 mM NADPH

Ehrlich_mitochondrial_superoxide.environment: 100 ug protein/mL; 250 mM sucrose; 20 mM HEPES; 100 uM EDTA; NADH; 4 uM rotenone; 5 min preincubation

PC3_intracellular_H2O2.limitations: Medium Amplex Red did not increase; catalase overexpression did not increase resistance.

unavailable_exact_system_parameters: accessible numerical doxorubicin semiquinone hyperfine tensor
solution encounter O2 g and ZFS tensors

baseline_no_optional_interactions.description: Illustrative field, encounter reaction, and escape benchmark with unavailable optional interactions omitted.

exchange_probe.description: Algebraic isotropic-exchange benchmark; 1e7 rad s^-1 is illustrative, not an estimate.

dipolar_probe.description: Algebraic anisotropic dipolar benchmark; magnitude and axis are illustrative, not geometry evidence.

oxygen_zfs_probe.description: Algebraic solution-encounter O2 ZFS benchmark; values are illustrative and not transferred from gas or matrix data.

hyperfine_mixing_probe.description: Deliberately illustrative local-field benchmark for D/Q mixing; not a doxorubicin hyperfine tensor.

relaxation_probe.description: Illustrative equal relaxation-rate benchmark; values are not T1 or T2 measurements.

full_pipeline_with_loss_probe.description: Illustrative end-to-end classical preparation/association, encounter, dismutation, SOD, and H2O2-loss probe.

pipeline_inputs.limitations: Every concentration, fraction, duration, and H2O2-loss value in this block is illustrative; none is a fitted or measured exact-system input.

sensitivity_grid.label: purely illustrative log grids, not chemically measured ranges
